a novel species, named Syntrophobacer sulfatireducen, was isolated and characterized from two UASB reactors treating brewery wastewater and bean curd wastewater.

the isolation and identification of a novel syntrophic bacterium which is able to oxidize propionate with sulfate as the terminal electron acceptor.

the isolation of two novel syntrophic propionate-oxidizers, and the characterization of the strains as a new species of the genus Syntrophobater, Syntrophoacter sulfatireductens sp. nov.
